newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - APRIL 3.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - APRIL 3.

text.p: The following stories were reported by Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at noon on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian parliament appointed Kazys Pednychia as new prosecutor general.
- EU Commissioner Hans van den Broek was positive over the work of Lithuania on its path to EU membership.

- Estonian Foreign Minister Toomas Ilves arrives to Vilnius on Thursday to discuss co-operation and the foreign affairs policy of the three Baltic countries and to talk about the bilateral relations of Lithuania and Estonia.
- Chairman parliament Vytautas Landsbergis leaves on Friday for the United States. He will visit Germany, the Czech Republic and Hungary on a tour which will end on April 11.
